cases.name: Kiarah Venisee-Rozelle
cases.about: Her Go Fund Me said: "Kiarah was the bright light that walked in any room, and her life was taken far too soon in a tragic domestic violence situation. Kiarah was deeply loved by family, friends, strangers, and anyone who had the chance to know her. She had just graduated from school with her licenses in surgical tech and had started a promising job with amazing opportunities ahead of her. Her future was bright, and her loss has left her family devastated."
